title: Count digits reference solution
answer:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { unsigned int n=0u; unsigned int copy=n; unsigned int digits=1u; while(copy>=10u) { copy/=10u; ++digits; } printf("%u\n",digits); return 0; }
